VALUE: These all look like the remains of grown men, except for one girl.
The missing mailman seems to be found. His body is mostly decomposed, as expected...
He had been missing for a month and a half.
There are bite marks out of all the severed limbs,
The person who committed these acts of murder, could climb walls, evident by the hand and feet marks.
The words "so hungry" were written in blood high enough that the climber must have written it.
This blood is very old. The smell as well as the blood color indicates that these were all at least a month old.
These marks should be looked out for, as they may lead to the culprit.
